node.data.keyValue.get.name: Get value by key
node.data.keyValue.get.description: Look up a case-sensitive key in an array of property maps or key/value pairs. Return the default only when the key is absent; omitted defaults return null. Dictionaries can also be supplied directly.
Automatic treats an object containing ex: Automatic treats an object containing exactly key/value or Key/Value as a pair; all other objects are property maps. Object array accepts arrays made by Key and value nodes. Pair array requires string keys. Duplicate matching keys fail; null values are returned as null, not replaced by the default.
